checks.name: Manifest, schemas, seed, references, media and declarations load
Infra exposes the lifecycle interface and host clock operation
MCP content and structured result agree
Read does not change business data
Caller cannot override run or role
Infra loads history, relationships and assets
Rejected history leaves business state unchanged
Duplicate has no additional state change
Same event ID with changed content is rejected
Old version cannot reset a changed App
A separate run retains its own initial data
Reset restores the loaded business baseline
New MCP process reads persisted App state
